name: Codex 折叠渲染
description: 按 phase 归组渲染模型回答：中间旁白、思考与工具调用收进一个可展开分组，生成时显示工作中，完成后显示用时并自动折叠，只留最终答案平铺。
descriptionEn: Groups reasoning, commentary and tool calls into one collapsible block per turn. Shows a working indicator while running and the elapsed time when done, leaving only the final answer flat.

name: 模型调度
description: 按时段配置主 bot 与子 bot 的模型/思考档位：可视化编辑时间窗（时区可搜索选择 + 本地时间预览）、可折叠窗口卡、当前生效窗口高亮、永不生效窗口告警与未保存修改保护，写入 ~/.pi/agent/model-schedule.jsonc，保存即生效。
descriptionEn: Time-of-day model routing for main/sub bots: searchable timezone picker with live local time, collapsible window cards, current-window highlight, never-matching window warnings and unsaved-change protection, written to ~/.pi/agent/model-schedule.jsonc.

name: Photon iMessage
description: Photon iMessage 通道：经本机 Photon sidecar（spectrum-ts gRPC 桥）在 Linux/macOS 上收发 iMessage，零公网 IP。机器人循环、输入动效、用户白名单、多轮会话隔离、/sessions 投票气泡切会话、斜杠命令与 AI photon 工具一应俱全。
descriptionEn: Photon iMessage channel for pi-web-ui: send & receive iMessages on Linux/macOS via a local Photon sidecar (spectrum-ts gRPC bridge) with zero public IP. Bot loop, typing indicator, allowlist, per-sender session isolation, a native-poll session picker, slash commands and the AI photon tool included.

name: multi-git
description: 多仓库 Git 总览：工作区内每个仓库的变更、差异、历史、分支、贮藏、跨仓搜索与时间线，另有工作区分支聚合、Fetch/Pull 与内置终端（其余只读）。
descriptionEn: Multi-repo Git overview: changes, diffs, history, branches, stashes, cross-repo search and a timeline for every repository in the workspace, plus a workspace-wide branch view, Fetch/Pull and an optional terminal.

name: 用量账本
description: 记录 pi-web-ui 自己的每一次模型调用：按模型统计调用数、TTFT、延迟、吞吐、缓存命中率、token 与成本，可查看逐条记录、按模型筛选并导出 CSV。成本优先用 SDK 记录，网关不回填时按公开价格表估算并分开展示；数据只来自本机会话与运行事件，不上传任何内容。
descriptionEn: Records every model call inside pi-web-ui: per-model counts, TTFT, latency, throughput, cache hit rate, tokens and cost. Cost prefers the SDK value and falls back to public price tables when the gateway reports zero, shown separately; data comes only from local sessions and run events.
